_comment: ★ Reaches the SYSTEM PROMPT as DATA via scout/context/source_registry.py -> SOURCE_REGISTRY_STR, interpolated in scout/agent.py under '## SOURCE REGISTRY'. Only these keys are rendered: source_name, source_type, description, directories (when source_type is 'files'), common_locations, the first 4 capabilities and the first 2 search_tips. Every directory listed here MUST actually exist on disk -- this file previously advertised company-docs, engineering-docs and data-exports, none of which have ever existed in this product.
description: The Word templates the firm uploads and the documents generated from them. This is a document store only -- company particulars, directors, members and the People register live in PostgreSQL and are reached through the company and register tools, not here.
content_types: DICA filing PDFs uploaded for extraction
capabilities: List the templates available to draft from
Read a specific file in full
limitations: Holds no company, director or member data -- that is in the database
Templates are only usable once they have been trained
A .docx must be read through the document tools, not as plain text
Previews and extracts are derived artefacts and are not authoritative
search_tips: Prefer the template and company tools; reach for raw files only when the answer is in the wording of a specific .docx
Search document text when you need the exact clause rather than a field value

directories.name: documents/legal/templates
directories.description: Word templates uploaded from the admin panel and trained before use
contains: AGM and EGM notices and minutes

directories.name: documents/legal/output
directories.description: Documents already generated for a company, tracked in the documents table
